mapper.sql: SELECT U.APLY_NO, U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.USER_ENPSWD, U.USER_SE_CD, U.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, U.DEPT_NM, U.MBL_TELNO, U.TELNO, U.EML_ADDR, U.DMND_AUTHRT_CD, A.AUTHRT_NM AS DMND_AUTHRT_NM, U.APLY_RSN, U.APLY_DT, U.APLY_STTS_CD, U.APRV_USER_ID, U.APRV_DT, U.RFSL_RSN FROM user_acnt_aply_info U LEFT JOIN authrt_info A ON A.AUTHRT_CD = U.DMND_AUTHRT_CD
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_acnt_aply_info WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter} AND APLY_STTS_CD IN ('WAITING', 'APPROVED'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_acnt_aply_info (APLY_NO, USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_ENPSWD, USER_SE_CD, OGDP_BZENTY_NM, DEPT_NM, MBL_TELNO, TELNO, EML_ADDR, DMND_AUTHRT_CD, APLY_RSN, APLY_DT, APLY_STTS_CD) VALUES (#{aplyNo}, #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{userEnpswd}, #{userSeCd}, #{ogdpBzentyNm}, #{deptNm}, #{mobileNo}, #{telno}, #{emlAddr}, #{dmndAuthrtCd}, #{aplyRsn}, NOW(), #{aplySttsCd})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM authrt_info WHERE AUTHRT_CD = #{_parameter} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_acnt_aply_info SET APLY_STTS_CD = 'APPROVED', APRV_USER_ID = #{aprvUserId}, APRV_DT = NOW(), RFSL_RSN = NULL WHERE APLY_NO = #{aplyNo} AND APLY_STTS_CD = 'WAITING'
